description.p: Mithril Viewer is a fast, lightweight image viewer built for both tiling window managers (Hyprland, Sway, i3) and full desktop environments (GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE) on Wayland and X11. It opens PNG, APNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, AVIF, ICO, TIFF, and QOI files, including animated images.

Mithril Viewer — быстрый и лёгкий просмотрщик изображений для Wayland и X11, одинаково удобный как в тайловых WM (Hyprland, Sway, i3), так и в полноценных DE (GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE). Открывает PNG, APNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, AVIF, ICO, TIFF и QOI, включая анимацию.

ul.li: Smooth cursor-centered zoom, panning, fit-to-window, and fullscreen viewing
Fast folder navigation with background neighbor image prefetching
Quick non-destructive edits: rotation, horizontal/vertical flip, and visual crop
Dark, neutral, and light themes with adjustable window opacity
Clipboard copy, CUPS printing, trash/delete confirmation, drag-and-drop, and set as desktop wallpaper

description.p: Initial release with broad raster/vector/animated format support, smooth zoom and pan, non-destructive rotate/flip/crop, neighbor prefetching, printing, and wallpaper integration.
